governance.note: Every entry is a planning record only. This registry grants no install/download/clone/pilot permission. A pilot requires an individually authorized task card in taskpacks/current plus user authorization for each external side effect. Licenses marked NOT_VERIFIED must be verified during DISCOVER/CLASSIFY before any pilot.

candidates.name: Orca
candidates.role: Open-source heavy workspace / first Pilot candidate (GOAL 12)
candidates.source: external open-source agent workspace (exact repo URL recorded at DISCOVER; not yet verified this round)
candidates.native_overlap: provides terminal/worktree/file/diff/multi-agent UI; WORK-LAB keeps governance, tasks, context, evidence, permissions, coordination. Windows maturity is user-stated (GOAL 12) and unverified in this round; confirm during DISCOVER.
candidates.integration_mode: launch external workspace -> native Codex inside -> git/test/evidence -> WORK-LAB readback
candidates.permissions: no new global config; per-pilot user authorization for any external write
candidates.data_boundary: project-local; candidate must not spill into E:/F:/ or other projects
candidates.pilot_trigger: user-authorized Orca Pilot task card executed against a real project
candidates.promotion_criteria: real pilot round: project launch + worktree identity + task correlation + exit/readback, with REAL evidence (GOAL 12 first round)

candidates.name: Omnigent

candidates.source: external open-source (exact repo recorded at DISCOVER)
candidates.native_overlap: Codex/Hermes/custom-agent session continuation + multi-agent orchestration; complements Orca (human workspace) as machine orchestration
candidates.integration_mode: future: WORK-LAB -> Omnigent (machine orchestration) + Orca (human workspace)
candidates.pilot_trigger: Orca Pilot stabilizes and machine-orchestration demand is confirmed
candidates.promotion_criteria: verified Codex/Hermes/custom-agent session continuation + multi-agent orchestration slice
